sayLines: A person, maybe 20s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A man, maybe 50s heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
A man, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers sets out to find A woman, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan. "Won't be long."
A woman, maybe 40s sets out to find A man, maybe 50s. "Won't be long."
A woman, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
📖 A woman, maybe 30s, with a nervous tic is re-packing the bundle, checking each thing twice before it goes back in.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Molt**. It resonates with: something unnamed.
